name: Kaito
approximate_height: About 160–165 cm (average early-teen height); reads slightly lanky next to peers

body_proportions.build: Slim teenage build; narrow shoulders; longish limbs without adult muscle mass
body_proportions.torso: Lean torso; jacket often slightly oversized for cozy silhouette
body_proportions.limbs: Slim arms and legs; knees and elbows subtly angular, not soft-chibi
body_proportions.hands: Youthful hands with slightly long fingers from constant drawing
body_proportions.notes: Keep proportions readable for coloring books: clear silhouette, no extreme stylization shifts between pages

face_shape: Soft oval with a gently pointed chin; youthful cheeks that can flush; not round-chibi and not sharp-adult
eye_shape: Large, expressive almond eyes with clear upper lids; irises readable in line art; strong catchlights when hopeful or amazed
eyebrow_characteristics: Medium-thick, slightly messy brows that angle up when determined and pinch together when anxious; brows are a primary emotion signal
nose_characteristics: Small simple nose: short bridge with a soft button tip in 3/4 views; often a minimal line or dot in front view to stay coloring-friendly
hairstyle: Messy spiky hair with uneven clumps; several forward spikes over the forehead; sides a bit shorter; looks like he forgot a comb but on purpose
hair_silhouette: Irregular spiky crown; highest spikes slightly off-center; readable dark outline even when hood is up (hood rarely fully covers spikes)
hair_length: Short-to-medium; spikes reach just above the eyes in front; nape short; no long trailing locks

clothing.default_outfit: Hooded jacket over a plain casual shirt or light undershirt, practical trousers, sneakers
clothing.coloring_notes: Keep garment regions clearly separated for flat coloring; zipper and pocket lines should stay consistent
clothing.season: Looks like mild weather / school-year casual; not heavy winter gear

jacket_design.closure: Center front zipper (show zipper pull in detail shots)
jacket_design.pockets: Two lower side pockets; optional small chest pocket consistent when shown
jacket_design.visual_priority: Jacket is the primary costume identifier across pages

hood_design.shape: Rounded hood with modest volume; not huge fantasy hood
wear_states: fully up rare—keep face and hair readable
hood_design.drawstrings: Two short drawstrings hanging when hood is down; keep length consistent
hood_design.interior: Simple lining suggestion only; avoid busy patterns

trousers.type: Practical straight or slightly tapered casual trousers / chinos
trousers.fit: Comfortable; not skinny, not baggy streetwear
trousers.pockets: Side seam pockets; optional back pocket outline
trousers.notes: Clean silhouette for coloring; avoid logos and elaborate seams

footwear.details: Simple toe cap, visible laces, modest sole thickness
footwear.notes: Keep left/right lace style consistent; no high-fashion redesigns mid-story

accessories: School bag / shoulder bag for sketchbook (when in transit)
Occasional pencil or brush in hand
No jewelry by default; no headphones required
posture_tendencies: Slight forward lean when curious or drawing
Shoulders rise and hunches when embarrassed or anxious
Opens chest and stands taller after mid-story courage turns
Often cradles sketchbook against side or chest
Weight shifts to one leg when listening

personality.core: Quiet, observant, kind, imaginative, conflict-avoidant until responsibility forces action
personality.social: Loyal to Ren; polite to adults; slow to trust crowds
personality.creative: Sees stories in margins; fears judgment; learns finishing is an act of courage
personality.values: Friendship, care for creations, honesty after mistakes

recurring_gestures: Ruffling own spiky hair when unsure
Brush or pencil held like a talisman
Offering an open palm to Sumi
Deep breath before a final stroke
features_allowed_to_change: Temporary dirt, ink stains on fingers or cuffs
Tired eye bags after heavy Echo use
Wind-tossed hair spikes in outdoor action
prohibited_variations: Long flowing hair or neat idol haircut
Chibi-only redesign as default (chibi ok only for optional gag inserts, not story continuity)
Replacing hooded jacket with unrelated costume without story reason
Changing eye shape to narrow sharp villain eyes as default
Adding scars, face paint, or heavy accessories
Gender-swap or age-swap variants in main continuity
continuity_notes: Locked concept: 14, slim teenage build, messy spiky hair, expressive eyes, hooded jacket, practical trousers, sneakers.
When Inkwell effects appear near Kaito, keep his anatomy stable—magic should not distort his core design.
Ink stains are temporary storytelling marks; wash off between clean scenes unless continuity requires them.
Sumi interactions should emphasize gentleness: crouch, open hand, eye-level with small fox.
Reference images are tracked separately in continuity.json; do not invent filenames as existing assets.
